name: Comfort Lasagna Soup
author: Woman's World - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: can (15 oz.) petite diced tomatoes with juice
cup fresh basil, chopped, plus more for garnish
uncooked lasagna noodles, broken into bite-size pieces
cup finely grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for garnish

instructions:
In large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion; cook 3 minutes. Stir in garlic; cook 1 minute. Add sausage; cook, breaking up with wooden spoon as it browns, about 10 minutes. Pour off any excess fat from pot and gradually stir in chicken stock.

Add tomatoes with juice, tomato paste, oregano, thyme and basil. Bring to boil over medium-high heat. Add lasagna noodles; cook until noodles are tender, 10-15 minutes. Reduce heat to low; stir in mozzarella and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle soup into bowls; top with Parmesan, fresh basil and ricotta, if desired.
